why.hunters: both ends up threefold: against 128 to 256 prey per site, a twentieth to over a third of their headcount hunting, so meals are many enough for where they fall to show
why.bite: 2 to 6 against prey bodies of 1 to 10, so a meal is a real share of a lean body and taking it from the wrong prey costs a life
why.appetite: 2 to 12, wider both ways: from hunters that eat only when nearly spent to hunters that eat nearly every tick
why.fat: each prey cohort carries 0 to 48 fat that only a hunt takes. Both prey lineages share their wants and rations, so their bodies settle in a narrow band and a draw by holdings barely differs from one by headcount; fat spreads holdings from about 1 to nearly 60. A draw by holdings takes mostly fat from fat prey, sparing bodies; a draw by headcount takes body from lean prey too, so the choice moves who starves. The upper end of 48 rather than 24 keeps shortages near zero outside the averaged crowd (c4b-boundary.txt)
why.hunters founded alike: a site's hunters are founded in one state, so which of them come first matters to nothing until prey run out part way through them
